frozen_before: the first SEC13D set and every SEC13D outcome; no SEC13D record existed when this file was committed
owner_decision: 2026-10-28, the owner: 'merge PR #16 and do 1, 2, 3, 4, 5' (items 1 and 2 of the session's proposal: a win-rate primary, and pre-declared extended looks); handoff/decisions/2026-10-28c_proof_program.md
applies_to: family SEC13D of research/CATALYST_REGISTER_v1/protocol.json, which stays unchanged; this file replaces only its decision_rule 'looks', 'fail' and 'counted' entries, and adds a second primary on the same records
why: power: one sealed set's paired difference has a spread near 0.21 (US_INSIDER_BUY 20-session returns), so at t >= 3 the smallest provable mean edge is 8.5% at 60 sets, 4.3% at 240, 2.1% at 960 and 1.5% at 1,920, and the smallest provable win rate against twins is 69%, 60%, 55% and 53%; the literature's 13D drift is 1-3% per event
sample: FIRE sets of family SEC13D, window H20, status RESOLVED with a paired difference (at least one twin traded)

MEAN.what: as protocol.json: per-session mean of (plan net - twins' mean net), one-sided t against 0, df = sessions - 1
MEAN.eligible_extra: the plan's mean net return after costs on these sets > 0

WIN_RATE.what: per set, a win is the plan's net above the twins' median net (the cone statement BEATS_TWINS_20); per-session share of wins, one-sided t of the session shares against 0.5, df = sessions - 1; the exact binomial p of all wins against 0.5 is reported beside it, descriptively (sets of one session are not independent)
WIN_RATE.eligible_extra: the plan's mean net return after costs on these sets > 0 (a high win rate with a losing mean is never eligible)

looks.note: 60/120/240 and their boundaries are protocol.json's; 480/960/1920 are pre-declared now and continue the same records; the t >= 3.0 floor binds at every extension look

at_a_look.eligible: t >= that look's t_min, one-sided p < 0.05, estimate > 0, and the primary's eligible_extra
at_a_look.futility: from the 240 look on, a primary whose estimate is <= 0 stops: FAIL (futility) for that primary
at_a_look.fail: a primary not eligible at the 1920 look fails
at_a_look.confirmed: eligible at a look and at the next look
at_a_look.family: the family stops when both primaries have stopped (futility, FAIL or confirmed); sealing may continue descriptively only if the owner says so

error: each primary has at most six looks at t >= 3.0 or stricter (one-sided normal tail 0.00135 at 3.0), so the chance that a null primary is ever eligible is at most 0.81% (Bonferroni over looks), at most 1.62% for the family; every look of every primary is a counted trial in research/QUANT_GRADE/trials, so the register's Holm adjustment sees all of them
counted: each look adds research/QUANT_GRADE/trials/CATALYST_REGISTER_v1_SEC13D_FIRE_<MEAN|WIN_RATE>_n<look>.json (counted); test numbers follow the order in which counted trial files are added
binding: every SEC13D CATALYST_SET sealed from now carries this file's id and sha256 under 'preregistration'; paper-verify refuses a set whose recorded sha256 differs from this file
